# Radeski Skin & Aesthetic Clinic

> Dermatology and cosmetology clinic in Uzbekistan with two branches, Fergana and Kokand: dermatology, dermato-oncology (moles, dermatoscopy, biopsy), trichology, podology (nails), phototherapy for psoriasis and vitiligo, IPL and laser treatments. Site languages: Uzbek (/uz), Russian (/ru), English (/en).

Contact details below were confirmed by the clinic's management in November 2026. Medical texts on the site are general information; diagnosis and treatment are decided by a doctor at a consultation.

## Branches

- Fergana (main clinic): O'zbekiston Ovozi street, 1B, Fergana. Phones: +998 73 200 73 73, +998 95 210 73 73. Hours: Monday–Saturday 08:00–18:00, Sunday closed. Page: https://radeski.uz/ru/fargona
- Kokand: 47-MFY, Huqandiy district, 144A, Kokand. Phone: +998 95 145 73 73. Hours: every day 08:00–20:00. Page: https://radeski.uz/ru/qoqon
- Both branches: https://radeski.uz/ru/branches
- Online booking: https://hipolink.net/radeskiskinclinicuz
